purpose: Prevent any cohort, identity, label, result artifact, comparator output or policy-selection dataset that has informed development from later being relabelled as fresh final evidence, and explicitly protect candidate future data from development-side outcome access.

locked_test.claim_rule: No final untouched claim may be made without independent custodian attestation and an overlap check against every registry version.

inspected_sets.name: all_history_development_before_fixed_monitor
inspected_sets.description: ALL_HISTORY training scope used all eligible development rows before the fixed monitor start; no subperiod inside that history may later be relabelled untouched merely because a new target decomposition is proposed.

protected_candidate_sets.name: post_monitor_prospective_candidate_after_2025_09_10
protected_candidate_sets.required_custodian_action: An independent custodian must choose and hash an admissible cohort, verify non-overlap/exposure against this registry, and attest that identities/outcomes were not exposed before the new contract and precision gate are frozen.
protected_candidate_sets.development_side_rule: Do not query, count, inspect, score, or stratify outcomes in this candidate period for study design or power rescue.

reason: historical candidate periods are already development-exposed
post-2025 candidate data must remain protected

a separate frozen contract and custodian-controlled cohort are required

minimum_attestation: statement that identities/outcomes were not exposed to development
overlap check against every inspected registry version
statement that the scientific contract and precision gate were frozen before outcome release
future_untouched_rule.if_attestation_unavailable: Describe evaluation as retrospective/development, not untouched or final superiority evidence.

maintenance_rule: Append every subsequently inspected cohort, comparator output, outage result, reconstruction, policy-selection dataset or protected-candidate access before it can influence development decisions. Never delete an inspected entry because a result is negative, obsolete or inconvenient.
